label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and panel titles.

shadows.name: rest

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled ember CTA for Get Started and primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff7a59; color: #1c100c; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0b429; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a59; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #57534e; background: #0c0a09; color: #f5f0eb; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #ff7a59; color: #ff7a59; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7a59; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(165deg, color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 92%, #ff7a59) 0%, #1c1917 42%, #1c1917 100%); border: 1px solid #3f3a36; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: #f5f0eb; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #a8a29e; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill filter; on-state uses the ember–gold gradient.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #57534e; background: transparent; color: #d6d3d1; font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-on { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7a59 0%, #f0b429 100%); border-color: transparent; color: #1c100c; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Nav tab
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { border: none; background: transparent; color: #a8a29e; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #f5f0eb; background: #1c1917; } .ds-tab-on { color: #f5f0eb; background: #1c1917; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #3f3a36; }

narrative.overview: The playground is a warm workshop, not a neon tool demo. Surfaces sit on charcoal stone or cream parchment; a coral ember and companion gold mark the one thing that moves — the cursor, the active control, the primary action. Voice is technical and concise. Proof is the live cursor, not marketing claims.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone / parchment, never cool navy or neon
Ember + gold as a single accent voice
System sans for UI; mono only for code
Tonal surfaces with 1px borders; small offset shadows
Custom cursor is the signature motion

rules.name: The Ember Voice Rule
rules.body: Ember and gold are one voice. Do not introduce a third accent. Gradient text is reserved for the brand wordmark only.

rules.name: The Stone Ground Rule
rules.body: Dark or light is chosen from the desk: a developer evaluating the library. Default follows prefers-color-scheme; both themes must exist.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: No second display family. Emphasis is weight and size.

rules.name: The Offset Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry offset and blur. A zero-offset colored halo is decoration, except the brand mark.

dos: Do prove the library with a live useCursor on marketing surfaces — the cursor is the product.
Do keep install commands copyable and short (npm / pnpm).
Do use ember for the active thing and mute for the rest.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: snap cursor, no trails, no UI animation.
donts: Don't introduce cool navy, electric blue CTAs, or a second brand accent.
Don't invent testimonials, download counts, or customer logos.
Don't wrap every section in a same-size icon+heading+text card grid.
Don't use gradient text except the existing brand wordmark.
Don't costume body copy in monospace.
